A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''noble''' from [[Tion]] was accused of murdering his own [[Unidentified Tion noble's brother|brother]]. Tion authorities have asked for an outside investigator to review the case to eliminate accusations of bias. The investigation revealed that the noble had been framed by his [[Unidentified Tion noble's sister|sister]], the actual murderer who hoped to remove both of her sibling rivals with one fell swoop.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|High-profile Case}}</ref>
